data.why: The dashboard is a read-only viewer; it has no upload or fetch feature, so the install step assembles a run directory from the project's own committed evidence/ and docs/figures/ files (a real, previously-executed analysis of the public 10x PBMC 3k dataset) rather than any file the browser hands the server.

goals: Inspect QC metrics (genes per cell, mito fraction) and how many of 2,700 input cells passed filtering
Explore the UMAP of Leiden clusters and the top marker genes that distinguish each cluster
Review which CellTypist labels dominate each cluster and how confidently (per-cluster consensus fractions)
Read the evidence-bounded biological interpretation attached to each cluster, including the one left deliberately unresolved
Assess the independent 5-class FACS benchmark: strict accuracy, macro-F1, MCC, and the confusion matrix for the annotation model
Check the provenance manifest to see which recorded inputs/outputs can still be verified by hash in this environment

review.summary: The tree tracks the dashboard's purpose closely: reviewing a saved PBMC 3k run from QC through labels, cautious interpretation, the FACS benchmark and hash provenance. Its screens hold up, and the replay agent reproduced every task and feature. It needs light fixes: one claim that the screens don't support (the 2,700 total), a missing feature for the evidence-bounded interpretation record, and explicit notes on the code-present views this install could not show.
